standard.summary: 控制 native SDXL 冻结 base
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.linear_cpu_pinned: Linear 放 CPU pinned 流过来。
optionDescriptions.linear_conv_cpu_pinned: Linear 和 Conv 都 pinned，更省更慢。

standard_en.summary: Controls the frozen base for native SDXL
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.resident: The frozen base weights stay resident on the GPU.
optionDescriptions.linear_cpu_pinned: Linear layers sit in CPU pinned memory and stream across.
optionDescriptions.linear_conv_cpu_pinned: Both Linear and Conv are pinned: saves more, runs slower.

advanced.principle: 控制 native SDXL 冻结 base 权重的驻留策略。显存足够选常驻 GPU；显存紧张可选 CPU pinned，Conv2d 模式更省显存但可能略慢。

advanced_en.principle: Controls the residency policy for native SDXL frozen base weights. Choose GPU-resident when VRAM suffices; when VRAM is tight choose CPU pinned — the Conv2d mode saves more VRAM but may be slightly slower.
